original: よく風邪引いちゃうの？

en.text: Do you catch colds often?

original: 風邪はよく引くの？

en.text: Do you catch colds often?

original: 風邪にはよくかかるの？

en.text: Do you catch colds often?

original: すごく気を付けてたのに、風邪引いちゃったんだ。

en.text: I was very careful, but I caught a cold.

original: 風邪を引いたみたい。少し熱っぽいの。

en.text: I seem to have caught cold. I'm a little feverish.

original: 風邪が治らないよ。

en.text: My cold isn't getting any better.

original: 風邪引いちゃったかも。

en.text: I may have caught a cold.

original: 風邪かな？

en.text: Do I have a cold?

original: 風邪引くなんて、最悪。

en.text: It sucks having a cold.

original: 寒くて風邪引くんじゃないかと思ったよ。

en.text: It was freezing so I thought that I'd catch a cold.

original: 寒くて風邪引きそうだったよ。

en.text: It was cold and it seemed like I would catch a cold.
It was cold and it looked like I may catch a cold.
It was cold and it seemed like I had caught a cold.
It was cold and it looked like I may have caught a cold.
It was cold and it seemed like I may have caught a cold.

original: 風邪を引いたみたい。

en.text: It seems I've caught a cold.
I think I've caught a cold.
It looks like I've caught a cold.

original: 風邪引いちゃった。

en.text: I've got a cold.
I've caught a cold.

original: 風邪が早く治るように、早く寝ます。

en.text: I will sleep early so my cold goes away sooner.

original: 風邪がひどくて、今週は勉強ができてないんだ。

en.text: A bad cold has kept me from studying this week.

original: タチの悪い風邪をもらってしまった。

en.text: I caught a bad cold.

original: 父は風邪を引いているんです。

en.text: My father is suffering from a cold.

original: トムはしょっちゅう風邪引いてるんだ。

en.text: Tom often catches colds.

original: 冬になるといつも風邪引いちゃうのよね。

en.text: I always get a cold in winter.

original: メアリーね、風邪引いて寝込んでたのよ。

en.text: Mary had a cold, so she stayed in bed.

original: 風邪でダウンしてるんだ。

en.text: I've been down with a cold.
I'm down with a cold.

original: あなたが風邪を引いたら、私がぶちぶち言われるんだから。

en.text: If you catch a cold, I'm going to get an earful.

original: 風邪引くよ。

en.text: You'll catch a cold.

original: この薬で風邪は治りますよ。

en.text: This medicine will cure your cold.
